d:
Bihar MLC chunav ke natijon ne rajy ki rajniti men naee charcha chher di hai. patna shikshak nirvachan kshetr men RJD ke do. sanjiv kumar ne BJP ke naval kishor yadav ko 1,057 voton se haraya. do. sanjiv kumar ko 4,487 aur naval kishor yadav ko 3,430 vot mile. is jit ke sath patna shikshak sit par naval kishor yadav ka lagatar panch chunav jitne ka silsila tut gaya.
Vahin, patna snatak sit par JDU ke niraj kumar aur jansuraj ke ummidvar anuj sinh ke bich mukabla charcha men raha. anuj sinh ko mokama ke vidhayak anant sinh ka samarthan prapt tha.
